chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd, from Muṣaddaq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: that he was asked about a man who has only one garment, and it is not permissible for him to perform salat (prayer) in it.
and he does not find water with which to wash it. How should he act? He said: He performs tayammum and offers salat (prayer), then when he obtains water, he washes it and repeats the salat (prayer).

key_terms.أَعَادَ الصَّلَاةَ: he repeated the prayer after proper purification
key_terms.ثَوْبٌ: garment or clothing worn for prayer
key_terms.غَسَلَهُ: he washed it after finding water
key_terms.يَتَيَمَّمُ: to perform tayammum as a substitute purification
key_terms.يَغْسِلُهُ: to wash it for ritual cleanliness

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if his only garment is affected by janabah and he has no water to wash it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one whose only garment is affected by janabah and who cannot find water to wash it. He should perform tayammum and pray, then when water becomes available, wash the garment and repeat the prayer.
